review_type: Qualitative machine-assisted inspection, not independent human gold labels
sample: 66 fresh records: 10 from each of six triage categories and all 6 automated candidates; randomized order, category hidden during text review

findings.finding: A generic thanks reply inherits a detailed property parent; relevant context does not make the reply substantive.
Off-plan/PHPP advice is property-related but lacks an explicit Dubai identifier in the available text. Shortness alone does not imply irrelevance.

Residential relocation after conflict has a housing link expressed through home/living/hotel rather than the rule's property vocabulary. This is a possible false exclusion under the geopolitical rule; eligibility still needs a scope-consistent judgment.
A substantive question about aircraft noise near Dubai South projects is padded with repeated sentences; within-record repetition needs separate handling from duplicate records.
Substantive lease/cap-rate discussion is mixed with a blog referral. Promotion and discussion can coexist.
A detailed liquidity/exit analysis uses listing-like units, prices and named locations; listing-format rules can mistake market analysis for an advertisement.
Long aviation/geopolitical discussion does not establish a property link merely by mentioning Dubai's economy.
Explicit property-linked geopolitical market expectations satisfy the user's property-link requirement.
A vague reaction under a tenancy dispute lacks a concrete argument; parent relevance is insufficient for substantive acceptance.
A short housing-price headline conveys specific market information despite fewer than twelve words.
Advice plus an agent referral is mixed-content; binary advertising rules need a predominant-purpose or multilabel policy.
A very short explicit property-price direction claim can be informative for expectations even if it lacks supporting evidence.
A Toronto property question is not automatically Dubai-relevant because it appears in a Dubai subreddit. Comparison context is missing.
A contact-only reply to a property-finance question should not inherit substantive status from the parent.

decision: Do not automatically accept or reject outliers using the current rule categories. Preserve all rows; use categories for review routing. Human-label evaluation and qualitative failures both show that a context-aware, separately validated relevance/discourse classifier is needed for automated recovery.
